blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation gives an autonomous vehicle a dense, pixel-level description of its surroundings and is a core part of scene understanding. Most segmentation networks consist of an encoder (the backbone) and a decoder, yet the backbone is often chosen without a systematic comparison. This work studies this choice on the BDD100K driving dataset. Four widely used decoders (U-Net, FPN, LinkNet and PSPNet) are combined with 13 backbones from six families (ResNet, VGG, DenseNet, Inception, MobileNet and EfficientNet), and all 52 models are trained with one common protocol. The best model, an FPN decoder with an EfficientNet-B4 backbone, reaches 62.6% mean intersection over union (mIoU), 89.8% accuracy and a loss of 0.092. Only two of the 52 models, both FPN with EfficientNet, exceed the 56.9% mIoU reported with the BDD100K benchmark. The effect of the backbone depends strongly on the decoder: the same EfficientNet-B4 gives 42.6% mIoU with PSPNet but 62.6% with FPN, and the gap between the best and the worst backbone ranges from 12.0 points (U-Net) to 42.5 points (FPN). The results and the scope of this study are discussed.
blocks.zh: 语义分割给一个自主的飞行器一个密集的,像素级的关于其周围的描述,是场景理解的核心部分. 大多数分块网络由编码器(骨干)和解码器组成,然而骨干却经常在没有系统比较的情况下被选择. 本作研究了BDD100K驱动数据集的这一选择. 4个广泛使用的解码器(U-Net,FPN,LinkNet和PSPNet)与来自6个家庭(ResNet,VGG,DenseNet,Inception,MobileNet和IncelNet)的13个骨干结合,所有52个型号都经过一个共同协议的培训. 最佳型号是一台具有高效Net-B4主干线的FPN解码器,在结合(mIoU)上达到62.6%的正交,准确度89.8%,损失0.092. 在52种模式中,只有2种模式,其中既有 " 高效网络 " 的 " FPN " 模式,都超过了按BDD100K基准报告的56.9%的MIOU。 骨干的作用很大程度上依赖于解码器:同样高效的Net-B4给与PSPNet的mIoU42.6%,而FPN的mIoU62.6%,最佳骨干和最差骨干之间的差距从12.0点(U-Net)到42.5点(FPN)不等. 报告讨论了这项研究的结果和范围。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Road safety is one of the strongest motivations for self-driving technology. Traffic accidents cause about 1.3 million deaths and 20–50 million injuries every year [ 1 ] , and more than 90% of crashes are linked to human error [ 2 ] . A self-driving system is usually described as a pipeline of sensing, perception and decision making [ 3 ] . Perception is a part where deep learning can help a lot: a vehicle can only take safe decisions if it understands the road, the lane markings, the traffic signs, and the vehicles and pedestrians around it.
blocks.zh: 道路安全是自驾技术最强的动机之一. 交通事故每年造成约130万人死亡和2千万至5千万人受伤[1],超过90%的车祸与人为错误[2]有关. 自驾系统通常被描述为感知,感知和决策的管道[3]. 洞察力是深入学习可以帮助很多方面:车辆只有在了解道路,车道标志,交通标志,车辆和周围行人的情况下才能作出安全的决定.

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation supports this understanding by assigning a class label (for example “road”, “sky”, “car” or “pedestrian”) to every pixel of a camera image [ 4 , 5 ] . For driving, the data must cover many lighting and weather conditions, and the model must find object boundaries precisely. Modern segmentation networks follow an encoder–decoder design. The encoder, called the backbone , extracts features from the image; the decoder turns these features back into a full-resolution label map. Many different backbones exist, but in practice one is often chosen in advance and the comparison focuses on the decoder.
blocks.zh: 语义分解通过给相机图像的每个像素分配一个分类标签(例如“道路”、“天空”、“汽车”或“pedestrian”)来支持这种理解[4、5]。 对于驾驶来说,数据必须涵盖许多照明和天气条件,模型必须精确地找到对象边界. 现代分区网络遵循编码器–解码器设计. 编码器称为主干线,从图像中提取特征;解码器将这些特征反转成全分辨率标签地图. 有许多不同的骨干存在,但在实际操作中,一个常常是事先选择的,比较的重点是解码器.

blocks.en: This paper asks a simple question: how much does the choice of backbone change the quality of semantic segmentation for driving scenes, and does the answer depend on the decoder? To answer it, this work presents a controlled study on BDD100K [ 6 ] , building on earlier work [ 7 ] . The contributions of this work are: • A systematic benchmark of 52 segmentation models: four decoders (U-Net, FPN, LinkNet, PSPNet) combined with 13 backbones from six families, all trained with the same protocol and reported with mIoU, pixel accuracy and loss. • The finding that FPN with an EfficientNet backbone is clearly the best combination in this study (62.6% mIoU with EfficientNet-B4), while the same backbone performs at the level of the other backbones with the other three decoders. • An analysis of backbone sensitivity, of the relation between mIoU, accuracy and loss, and of the scope of the study, which points to concrete next steps.
blocks.zh: 本文提出一个简单的问题:骨干选择对驾驶场景的语义分割质量有多大变化,答案是否取决于解码器? 为了回答这个问题,本项工作对BDD100K [6] 进行了控制性研究,以先前的工作为基础[7]。 这项工作的贡献是: • 52个分区模型的系统基准:4个解码器(U-Net、FPN、LinkNet、PSPNet)与来自6个家庭的13个骨干结合,所有骨干都经过同样的协议培训,并以mIoU报告,像素精度和损失. 发现具有高效网络主干网的FPN显然是本研究的最佳组合(62.6%的mIoU与高效网络-B4),而同一主干网则与其他三个解码器一起在其他主干网一级运行。 分析骨干敏感性,mIoU的关系,准确度和损失,研究范围,指出下一步的具体步骤.

blocks.en: A systematic benchmark of 52 segmentation models: four decoders (U-Net, FPN, LinkNet, PSPNet) combined with 13 backbones from six families, all trained with the same protocol and reported with mIoU, pixel accuracy and loss.
blocks.zh: 52个分区模型的系统基准:4个解码器(U-Net,FPN,LinkNet,PSPNet)与来自6个家庭的13个主干线结合,都经过同样的协议培训,并以mIoU报告,像素精度和损失.

blocks.en: The finding that FPN with an EfficientNet backbone is clearly the best combination in this study (62.6% mIoU with EfficientNet-B4), while the same backbone performs at the level of the other backbones with the other three decoders.
blocks.zh: 发现具有高效网络主干线的FPN显然是本研究中最好的组合(62.6%的mIoU与高效网络-B4),而同一主干线与其他三个解码器在主干线的层面上运行.

blocks.en: An analysis of backbone sensitivity, of the relation between mIoU, accuracy and loss, and of the scope of the study, which points to concrete next steps.
blocks.zh: 分析骨干敏感性,mIoU的关系,准确度和损失,研究范围,指出下一步的具体步骤.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Segmentation Architectures
blocks.zh: II-A 分区结构

blocks.en: Fully convolutional networks (FCN) [ 8 ] showed that a classification network can be turned into a dense predictor. Encoder–decoder networks such as SegNet [ 9 ] and U-Net [ 10 ] then added a decoder that recovers spatial detail; U-Net also copies encoder features to the decoder by skip connections and was first designed for biomedical images. Several works improve the use of context. PSPNet [ 11 ] pools the feature map at several scales to collect global context. The DeepLab family uses atrous (dilated) convolution and atrous spatial pyramid pooling [ 12 , 13 ] , and DeepLabv3+ adds a light decoder [ 14 ] . HRNet [ 15 ] keeps a high-resolution representation through the whole network. Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN) [ 16 ] build a pyramid of features with a top-down path and lateral connections; they were proposed for object detection and are also effective for segmentation [ 17 ] . LinkNet [ 18 ] was designed for efficiency: it links each encoder block to the matching decoder block to keep the number of parameters low. More recent work uses vision transformers and attention-based decoders, such as SegFormer [ 19 ] and Mask2Former [ 20 ] , and modernized convolutional backbones such as ConvNeXt [ 21 ] . This paper focuses on classical convolutional encoder–decoder networks, which remain a common baseline. Surveys of deep segmentation are given in [ 22 , 5 ] ; for driving scenes, see [ 4 , 23 ] , and [ 24 ] for a comparison of real-time networks.
blocks.zh: 充分演化的网络(FCN)[8]显示一个分类网络可以变成一个密集的预测器. 编码器–解码器网络如SegNet[9]和U-Net[10],然后增加了一个恢复空间细节的解码器;U-Net也通过跳过连接复制解码器的编码器特性,并首先为生物医学图像设计. 若干工作改进了环境的使用。 PSPNet [11] 将特征映射集成多个尺度来收集全球背景. DeepLab家族使用芳香(稀释)蒸发和芳香的空间金字塔集合[12,13],DeepLabv3+添加了光解码器[14]. HRNet [15]通过整个网络保持高分辨率代表. 地物金字塔网络 (FPN) [16] 搭建一个带有自上而下路径和横向连接的特征金字塔;它们被提议用于对象检测,并且对分割也有效 [17]. LinkNet [18] 为提高效率而设计:它将每个编码器块链接到匹配的解码器块,以保持参数数低. 较近期的作品使用视觉变压器和基于注意力的解码器,如SegFormer [19]和Mask2Former [20],以及现代化的革命骨干,如ConvNEXt [21]. 本文着重论述古典式编解码器-解码器网络,这些网络仍然是共同的基准. 对深层分割的勘察参见[22,5];关于驾驶场景,参见[4,23],实时网络比较参见[24].

blocks.en: II-B Backbones
blocks.zh: II-B 背骨

blocks.en: The encoder of a segmentation network is normally an image-classification network used as a feature extractor. ResNet [ 25 ] uses residual connections to train deep networks, VGG [ 26 ] stacks small convolution filters, DenseNet [ 27 ] connects every layer to all later layers in a block, and Inception [ 28 , 29 ] uses parallel filters of different sizes. MobileNet [ 30 , 31 ] uses depthwise separable convolutions to reduce computation. EfficientNet [ 32 ] scales network depth, width and input resolution together with one compound coefficient instead of scaling a single dimension. Using pretrained backbones (transfer learning) is standard practice, because it lets the segmentation model reuse features learned on a large classification dataset such as ImageNet [ 33 , 34 ] . Better classification backbones usually transfer better to other tasks, but the relation is not perfect [ 35 ] , which is one more reason to compare backbones directly.
blocks.zh: 分区网络的编码器通常是一种图像分类网络,作为特性提取器使用. ResNet [25] 使用剩余连接来训练深层网络,VGG [26] 堆积小演化滤波器,DenseNet [27] 将每个层连接到一个块中所有后期的层,Inception [28,29] 使用不同大小的平行滤波器. MobileNet [30, 31] 使用深度可分解的编组以减少计算. 高效Net[32]比例网深度,宽度和输入分辨率加一个复合系数,而不是缩放一个维度. 使用预先训练的骨干(transfering learning)是标准做法,因为它让在ImageNet[33,34]等大型分类数据集上学到的分化模型再利用特性. 更好的分类主干线通常会更好地转移到其他任务,但关系并不完美[35],这也是直接比较主干线的另一个原因.

blocks.en: II-C Driving Datasets
blocks.zh: II-C 驱动数据集

blocks.en: Public datasets for urban scenes include CamVid [ 36 ] , KITTI [ 37 ] , Cityscapes [ 38 ] and Mapillary Vistas [ 39 ] . BDD100K [ 6 ] contains 100K driving videos with ten tasks, recorded in different cities, at different times of day and in different weather. The BDD100K paper reports 56.9% mIoU for a semantic segmentation model trained on segmentation data alone, and 58.3% when it is trained jointly with object detection data. The first number is used as a reference point in Section V .
blocks.zh: 城市场景的公共数据集包括 CamVid [36], KITTI [37], Cityscapes [38] 和 Mapillery Vistas [39]. BDD100K [6] 包含100K 驱动视频,有十项任务,记录在不同城市,不同时段和不同天气. BDD100K文件报告 56.9%的mIoU用于语义分解模型,仅接受分解数据培训,58.3%与物体检测数据联合培训。 第一个编号在第五节用作参考点。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Overall Design
blocks.zh: 总体设计

blocks.en: Fig. 1 shows the pipeline. An RGB image is passed through a backbone that is initialized with pretrained weights. A decoder uses the backbone features to build a high-resolution representation, and a final convolution with a softmax activation gives one probability per class for each pixel. Any backbone can be combined with any decoder, so the pipeline allows a controlled comparison where only one component changes at a time.
blocks.zh: 图1显示管道。 一个RGB图像通过一个以预先训练的重量初始化的骨干传递. 解码器使用骨干特性来构建一个高分辨率的表示,一个带有软max激活的终极演化给每个像素的每类一个概率. 任何主干线都可以与任何解码器结合,因此管道允许一次只有一个组件变化的可控比较.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Pipeline used in this study. The backbone and the decoder are interchangeable; 13 backbones and four decoders give 52 models.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1:本研究使用的管道. 骨干和解码器可互换;13个骨干和4个解码器给出52个型号.

blocks.en: III-B Decoders
blocks.zh: 三-B 解码器

blocks.en: Four decoders are evaluated; they differ mainly in how they bring information from the encoder to the output.
blocks.zh: 四个解码器被评价;它们主要在如何将信息从编码器带入输出方面有所不同.

blocks.en: U-Net [ 10 ] has a contracting path and a symmetric expanding path. At each step of the expanding path the feature map is upsampled with an up-convolution and concatenated with the feature map of the same resolution from the contracting path.
blocks.zh: U-Net [10]有订约路径和对称的扩张路径. 在扩展路径的每一个步骤上,特征图都用一个向上演化的图样进行检验,并用同一解析度的特征图从订约路径中调出.

blocks.en: FPN [ 16 ] has a bottom-up pathway (the backbone), a top-down pathway and lateral connections (Fig. 2 ). The top-down pathway upsamples semantically strong but coarse maps by a factor of two with nearest-neighbor interpolation. Each lateral connection applies a 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution to the backbone map of the same size and merges it with the upsampled map by element-wise addition.
blocks.zh: FPN [16] 有自下而上的路径(骨干),自上而下的路径和横向连接(图2 ). 自上而下路径的上图显示有强壮但粗糙的地图,其系数为近邻插值的2。 每个横向连接对大小相同的主干图应用1×1 1 折射,并通过元素加法将其与上图合并.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: FPN decoder on top of a backbone. Each backbone stage C i C_{i} is reduced with a 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution and added to the 2 × 2{\times} upsampled map from the level above (the top level has no map above), which gives the pyramid maps P i P_{i} ; these are merged for the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:FPN解码器在骨干上方. 每个主干阶段 C i C _{i} 都用 1 × 1 × 1 × × 1 切变 并加到 2 × × 2 × × × × ======== 上面一层的地图(上面一层没有地图),它给出了金字塔地图P i P _{i};这些地图被合并进行最后预测。

blocks.en: LinkNet [ 18 ] uses an initial 7 × 7 7{\times}7 convolution with stride two, followed by residual encoder blocks. The input of every encoder block is linked to the output of the matching decoder block, which recovers spatial detail with few extra parameters.

blocks.en: PSPNet [ 11 ] applies a pyramid pooling module to the last feature map. The map is average-pooled into 1 × 1 1{\times}1 , 2 × 2 2{\times}2 , 3 × 3 3{\times}3 and 6 × 6 6{\times}6 sub-regions; each level is reduced with a 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution, upsampled bilinearly, and concatenated with the original map to combine local and global context.
III-C Backbones and Transfer Learning
blocks.zh: 三-C 背骨和转移学习

blocks.en: The study uses 13 backbones: ResNet-34 and ResNet-50 [ 25 ] ; VGG-16 and VGG-19 [ 26 ] ; DenseNet-121, -169 and -201 [ 27 ] ; Inception-v3 [ 28 ] and Inception-ResNet-v2 [ 29 ] ; MobileNet [ 30 ] and MobileNetV2 [ 31 ] ; and EfficientNet-B3 and -B4 [ 32 ] . Every backbone is initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights [ 33 ] and then trained for segmentation.
blocks.zh: 该研究使用了13个主干线:ResNet-34和ResNet-50 [25];VGG-16和VGG-19 [26];DenseNet-121, -169和 -201 [27];Inception-v3 [28]和Inception-ResNet-v2 [29];MobileNet [30]和MobileNetV2 [31];以及高效率的Net-B3和-B4 [32]. 每个骨干都初始化了ImageNet的预置权重[33],然后经过分化训练.

blocks.en: III-D Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 三-D 数据编制

blocks.en: The ground-truth masks of BDD100K are color images in which each class has a fixed RGB color. For training, each mask is converted into an integer label map by looking up the color of every pixel in a table of class colors. The table has 22 label indices, including the “unlabeled” and “static” indices, and every pixel receives the index of its matching color.
blocks.zh: BDD100K的地面真人面具是每个类都有固定RGB颜色的彩色图像. 对于训练,每个口罩通过在类色表中查找每个像素的颜色,转换成整数标签图. 该表有22个标签指数,包括“无标签”和“静态”指数,每个像素都得到其匹配颜色的指数。

blocks.en: III-E Loss and Metrics
blocks.zh: 三-E 损失和计量

Three quantities are reported. blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 四 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A Data
blocks.zh: 数据

blocks.en: The study uses BDD100K [ 6 ] , collected by the University of California, Berkeley. It contains 100K driving videos of about 40 seconds each, recorded at 720p and 30 fps with GPS/IMU data, on more than 50K rides in New York, the San Francisco Bay Area and other regions. It covers city streets, residential areas and highways, in different weather and at different times of day. Models are trained and evaluated on the labeled segmentation images, which are divided into 70% training, 10% validation and 20% test images. The small CamVid dataset [ 36 ] (701 annotated frames) was also used as an auxiliary set; its size made it easy to test the models and to find implementation errors quickly. All results in this paper are on BDD100K. All reported results (mIoU, accuracy and loss) are computed on the test images.
blocks.zh: 该研究使用加州大学伯克利分校收集的BDD100K [6]. 它包含100K驱动视频,每集约40秒,记录在720p和30fps,并附有GPS/IMU数据,涉及纽约,旧金山湾区等地区的超过50K骑行. 它覆盖城市街道,居民区和高速公路,在不同天气和不同时段. 模型在标注的分区图像上经过培训和评价,分为70%的培训,10%的验证和20%的测试图像. 小CamVid数据集[36](701个注解框)也被用作辅助集;其尺寸使得测试模型和快速发现执行错误变得容易. 本文中的所有结果均为BDD100K. 所有报告的结果(mIoU、准确度和损失)均在测试图像上计算。

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation and Training
blocks.zh: 执行和培训

blocks.en: All networks are implemented in Python with TensorFlow [ 40 ] and Keras, using an open-source Keras/TensorFlow library of segmentation networks. The training protocol follows [ 7 ] , and all 52 models share the hyperparameters in Table I . Training uses the Adam optimizer [ 41 ] . The experiments ran on a server with an Intel Xeon Silver 4210R CPU (2.40 GHz), 128 GiB of memory, four Tesla K80 GPUs and one Tesla V100S GPU (32 GB). Training and evaluating all 52 models took about 130 hours in total on this machine.
blocks.zh: 所有网络在Python与TensorFlow[40]和Keras一起实施,使用开源的Keras/TensorFlow分块网络库. 训练规程遵循[7],所有52种型号都共享表一中的超参数. 训练使用亚当优化器 [41]. 实验运行在一个服务器上,一个Intel Xeon Silver 4210R CPU (2.40 GHz),128 GiB 内存,四个Tesla K80 GPU和一个Tesla V100S GPU (32 GB). 所有52个型号的培训和评价共花费了大约130个小时使用此机.

blocks.en: V Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: V-A Main Results
blocks.zh: 主要成果

blocks.en: Table II and Fig. 3 give the mIoU of all 52 models, and Table III gives their accuracy and loss. The best model is FPN with an EfficientNet-B4 backbone. It reaches 62.6% mIoU and the highest accuracy (89.8%), with a loss of 0.092. FPN with EfficientNet-B3 is second (58.6% mIoU, 87.0% accuracy). The next best model, FPN with DenseNet-201, reaches only 44.3% mIoU, so the two EfficientNet models are separated from the rest of the field by more than 14 points.
blocks.zh: 表二和图3列出所有52种模型的MIOU,表三列出其准确性和损失。 最好的模式是具有高效Net-B4主干线的FPN. 它达到62.6%的mIoU和最高的精度(89.8%),损失0.092. 具有高效网-B3的FPN是第二位(58.6%的mIoU,87.0%的精度). 下个最佳型号是DenseNet-201的FPN,只达到44.3% mIoU,因此两个高效Net型号与球场其余部分分离超过14分.

blocks.en: TABLE II: mIoU (%) of every decoder–backbone combination on BDD100K. The best backbone for each decoder is in bold.
blocks.zh: 表二:BDD100K上每个解码器-背骨组合的mIoU(%). 每个解码器最好的骨干用粗体表示.

blocks.en: Fig. 3: mIoU (%) for each backbone and decoder. The dashed line is the 56.9% mIoU reported with the BDD100K benchmark for segmentation-only training [ 6 ] . Only FPN with EfficientNet-B3 and -B4 is above this line.
blocks.zh: 图3:每个骨干和解码器的mIoU(%). 虚线为56.9%的mIoU报告,与BDD100K基准仅用于分区化培训[6]. 只有具有高效Net-B3和-B4的FPN在本行以上.

blocks.zh: 表三: 经常预算 测试精度(cc,%)和每个模型的丢失. 每个解码器的最佳准确性和最低损失用粗体表示.

blocks.en: V-B Effect of the Backbone
blocks.zh: 背骨的作用

blocks.en: The backbone matters, but how much depends on the decoder. Within one decoder, the difference between the best and the worst backbone is 12.0 points for U-Net, 18.6 for LinkNet, 20.0 for PSPNet and 42.5 for FPN. MobileNetV2 is the worst backbone for all four decoders (20.1–31.4% mIoU), and for FPN its accuracy falls to 43.8%. This behavior deserves a closer analysis, for example with a tuned training setup; in the following comparison these runs are treated as outliers.
blocks.zh: 骨干很重要 但多少取决于解码器 在一个解码器内,最佳主干线和最差主干线的区别为U-Net的12.0分,LinkNet的18.6分,PSPNet的20.0分,FPN的42.5分. 移动 净额 V2是所有四个解码器(20.1-31.4% mIoU)最差的骨干,FPN的精度下降到43.8%. 这种行为值得进行更仔细的分析,例如用一个调制的训练设置;在接下来的比较中,这些跑步被视作超越者.

blocks.en: Among the other backbones the picture is more regular. VGG-19 is below VGG-16 for all four decoders, and the two VGG networks are the weakest backbones after MobileNetV2. A deeper backbone is not always better: ResNet-50 is below ResNet-34 with U-Net, FPN and LinkNet, and DenseNet-201 is the weakest DenseNet with U-Net and PSPNet. The light MobileNet is competitive with U-Net, LinkNet and PSPNet: it is within four points of the best backbone for each of them, which makes it interesting when computation is limited; measuring its inference time and model size is a useful next step.
blocks.zh: 在其他骨干中,图片较为常见. VGG-19对于所有四个解码器都低于VGG-16,两个VGG网络是MobileNetV2之后最弱的骨干. 更深层的骨干并非总能更好:ResNet-50与U-Net,FPN和LinkNet在ResNet-34之下,而DenseNet-201则是使用U-Net和PSPNet最弱的DenseNet. 轻移动网与U-Net,LinkNet和PSPNet具有竞争能力:它位于各自最佳主干线的四点之内,这在计算有限时让人感兴趣;测量其推论时间和模型大小是有用的下一步.

blocks.en: V-C Interaction Between Backbone and Decoder
blocks.zh: V- C 后骨和解码器之间的相互作用

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Mean mIoU (%) per backbone family: over the three decoders U-Net, LinkNet and PSPNet, and with FPN.
blocks.zh: 表四:每个骨干家庭的平均mIoU(%):超过三个解码器U-Net、LinkNet和PSPNet,以及FPN。

blocks.en:
The most striking result is the interaction between EfficientNet and FPN. Table IV averages the mIoU over the backbones of each family. For the five other families, the FPN average differs from the average of the other decoders by at most 4.5 points (from − 2.2 -2.2 to + 4.5 +4.5 ). For EfficientNet the difference is + 18.9 +18.9 points (60.6% against 41.7%).
With U-Net, LinkNet and PSPNet, EfficientNet-B3 and -B4 give 39–44% mIoU, similar to most other backbones. With FPN they give 58.6% and 62.6%. The decoder alone does not explain this, because FPN with the other backbones gives 20–44%; the backbone alone does not explain it either. A plausible explanation is that FPN merges features from several stages with lateral connections, which suits the multi-scale features of a compound-scaled network such as EfficientNet. Ablation studies and repeated training runs can test this explanation in future work.
blocks.zh:
最引人注目的结果是高效网络与FPN之间的互动. 表四平均显示每个家庭的MIOU高于骨干。 对另外五个家庭来说,FPN平均值与其他解码器的平均值相比,最高为4.5点(从−2.2-2.2到+4.5+4.5.)。 高效 净差为+18.9+18.9分(60.6%对41.7%).
有了U-Net,LinkNet和PSPNet,效率网-B3和-B4给出39–44 % mIoU,与大多数其他骨干类似. 有了FPN,它们给予58.6%和62.6%。 单是解码器并不能解释这一点,因为FPN和其他骨干给出了20–44 %;单是骨干也无法解释. 一个合理的解释是,FPN将几个阶段的特征与横向连接合并,这符合诸如效率网等复合规模网络的多尺度特征。 阅读研究和反复培训可以在今后的工作中检验这种解释。

blocks.en: V-D Accuracy, Loss and mIoU
blocks.zh: V-D 准确性、损失和微调

blocks.en: Over the 52 models, mIoU and accuracy rank the models almost in the same way (Spearman correlation 0.97), and mIoU and loss are also correlated (Spearman − 0.77 -0.77 ). However, the two measures have very different ranges. If MobileNetV2 and the two FPN–EfficientNet models are left out, 40 of the remaining 46 models have 78–86% accuracy, while all of them have only 31.6–44.3% mIoU. This is typical for imbalanced data: frequent classes cover most pixels and make the accuracy high, while rare classes lower the mIoU.
blocks.zh: 在52个模型中,mIoU和精度几乎以同样的方式排列模型(Spearman conversation 0.97),mIoU和损失也是相互关联的(Spearman − 0.77-0.77)。 然而,这两项措施的范围大不相同。 如果将MobileNetV2和两个FPN-EfficentNet模型排除在外,其余46个模型中有40个有78-86%的精度,而所有模型只有31.6-44.3 % mIoU. 这在不平衡的数据中是典型的:频繁的类覆盖大多数像素并使精度高,而罕见的类降低mIoU.

blocks.en: The loss does not always agree with mIoU. The lowest loss (0.084) belongs to FPN with ResNet-34, which has only 42.9% mIoU; FPN with EfficientNet-B4 has the second lowest loss (0.092) but the highest mIoU and accuracy. For this reason, mIoU rather than the loss is recommended for choosing the model.
blocks.zh: 损失并不总是与mIoU一致. 最低损失(0.084)属于配有ResNet-34的FPN,其mIoU只有42.9%;配有高效Net-B4的FPN拥有第二低损失(0.092)但mIoU和准确度最高. 为此,建议选择型号时使用mIoU而不是损失.

blocks.en: V-E Comparison with the BDD100K Reference
blocks.zh: V-E 与 BDD100K 比较 参考

blocks.en: The BDD100K paper reports 56.9% mIoU for segmentation-only training [ 6 ] . The best model is 5.7 points higher (62.6%), and FPN with EfficientNet-B3 is 1.7 points higher. All other 50 models are below this value, by more than 12 points. This comparison is indicative, because the data split, the label set and the evaluation protocol of the benchmark paper may differ in details from those of this study.
blocks.zh: BDD100K文件报告 56.9%的MIOU只用于分区化培训[6]. 最佳模式为5.7分高(62.6%),使用高效Net-B3的FPN为1.7分高. 其他50个模型都低于这个值,比12分多. 这种比较是指示性的,因为数据分割,标签集和基准文件的评价协议在细节上可能不同于本研究.

blocks.en: V-F Scope of the Study
blocks.zh: V-F 研究范围

blocks.en: This work is a controlled empirical comparison: all 52 models use one protocol, so the differences between them come from the choice of backbone and decoder. The main trends are large and clear, for example the gap between FPN with EfficientNet and all other models. Small differences between backbones with similar mIoU (for example 41–43%) are best read as comparable performance. The evaluation uses mIoU, pixel accuracy and loss; per-class IoU and qualitative examples would add detail on which classes benefit most from a better backbone. The class imbalance of the data can be studied further with class weights or imbalance-aware losses such as the Dice loss [ 42 ] or the focal loss [ 43 ] (see [ 44 ] for a survey). Parameter counts and inference speed are natural additions for in-vehicle use, and transformer-based networks are a natural extension of the same benchmark.
blocks.zh: 这部作品是一种可控的经验比较:所有52个模型都使用一个协议,所以它们之间的差异来自于主干和解码器的选择. 主要趋势是大而明确的,例如,利用高效网络的FPN与所有其他模式之间的差距。 具有类似mIoU(例如41–43%)的骨干之间的小差异最好被理解为可比性能. 评价使用mIoU,像素精确度和损失;每类IoU和定性实例将增加细节,说明哪些类从更好的骨干中受益最大. 数据等级失衡可随类权重或不平衡-意识损失,如Dice损失[42]或焦损失[43](调查参见[44])而进一步研究. 参数计数和推算速度是用于车辆的自然添加,基于变压器的网络是同一基准的自然延伸.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 六. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This work compared 52 combinations of four decoders and 13 backbones for semantic segmentation on BDD100K. The choice of backbone has a large effect, and this effect depends on the decoder. FPN with an EfficientNet-B4 backbone was the best model, with 62.6% mIoU, 89.8% accuracy and a loss of 0.092, and it was the only model family that exceeded the 56.9% mIoU of the benchmark reference. Better segmentation gives the vehicle a better understanding of the road scene.
blocks.zh: 这项工作比较了BDD100K上的52个组合的4个解码器和13个主干器进行语义分割. 骨干的选择效果很大,这种效果取决于解码器. 具有高效Net-B4主干线的FPN是最佳模式,拥有62.6%的mIoU,89.8%的精度,损失0.092,是唯一一个超过基准参考的56.9%mIoU的模型家族. 更好的分割使车辆更好地了解道路场景.

blocks.en: Several directions follow from this work. First, repeat the experiments with several random seeds, add ablations to explain the FPN–EfficientNet interaction, and report per-class IoU, parameter counts and speed. Second, address class imbalance with class weights or other loss functions, and compare with transformer-based networks such as SegFormer [ 19 ] . Third, test the best model on adverse conditions: a new snowy-weather dataset could be built, or existing data such as Mapillary Vistas [ 39 ] and the Canadian Adverse Driving Conditions dataset [ 45 ] could be used. Fourth, check whether the model works in multi-task learning and in other domains such as medical images [ 46 ] and aerial images [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项工作有好几个方向。 首先,用数个随机种子重复实验,增加调试来解释FPN–EfficentNet交互,并报告每类IoU,参数计数和速度. 二,用类权重或其他损失功能解决类失衡问题,并与SegFormer [19]等基于变压器的网络进行比较. 第三,在不利条件下测试最佳模型:可以建立一个新的积雪天气数据集,或者可以使用马比利维斯塔斯[39]和加拿大不利驾驶条件数据集[45]等现有数据. 第四,检查该模型是否在多任务学习以及医疗图像[46]和航空图像[47]等其他领域发挥作用.
